key_insight: ProtoDiffusion generates editable multi-layer designs using one shared spatial prototype and one vector per layer, reducing latent token count from NHW to HW+N before backbone-specific packing.
engineering_relevance: The compact representation supports image- and text-conditioned design generation without requiring a layer count or layout as input, while allowing optional bounding-box guidance.
method: ProtoVAE encodes a design into a shared spatial prototype and per-layer candidate vectors.
Each candidate conditions a shared decoder to reconstruct its RGBA layer.
Diffusion jointly denoises the prototype and fixed candidate slots, leaving unused slots empty.
evidence_signal: Reported results include 40.43 dB layer-crop reconstruction PSNR, LayerD image-to-design RGB L1 of 0.040 with boxes, and text-to-design FID of 66.41 versus 86.84 for FLUX.2 [klein].
watch_item: Fixed candidate slots impose a layer-capacity limit, and fewer latent tokens do not by themselves establish end-to-end memory or runtime savings across backbones.
paper_title: ProtoDiffusion: Token-per-Layer Generative Modeling of Multi-Layer Images
